name: wolfxl
summary: Openpyxl-compatible Excel library with a Rust backend: speed up openpyxl code with one import change and edit .xlsx templates without losing formatting, conditional formatting, or data validation. WolfXL 2.0.21 measured 6.7-12.0x faster than openpyxl 3.1.5 on the committed read/write benchmark (small-file gains vary). MIT.
author: Wolfgang Schoenberger
